value.rationale: At fixed reset-location variance and diffusion strength, the far-tail decay exponent alone selects three qualitatively different rare-reset dissipation regimes. Smooth quartic resetting exhibits the physically surprising divergence as r tends to zero; the exact positive-coefficient polynomial proves strict all-rate monotonicity for the complete natural even-power potential family. The cutoff motivates designing/diagnosing reset preparation noise and is not an arbitrary table slice.
